name: Gelateria la Fragola
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gelateria la Fragola in Tirol!**

Indulge in the finest Italian gelato crafted with love in the heart of the Alps. Our creamy, artisanal flavors—from classic **Stracciatella** to seasonal specialties like **Tiroler Apfelstrudel**—are made with the freshest ingredients, just for you.

Visit us in **Innsbruck**, where the charm of the city meets the magic of authentic Italian gelato. Whether you're strolling through the **Goldenes Dachl** or relaxing by the **Inn River**, treat yourself to a moment of pure joy with every scoop.

**Gelateria la Fragola**—where tradition meets taste in the breathtaking landscapes of **Tirol**.
